name: dnd-plugin
description: Create, edit and roll guest D&D 5.5e character sheets with inline dice results and optional private play sessions.

interface.longDescription: A D&D 5.5e character sheet for the 2024 revised fifth edition: abilities, skills, combat, spells, features, equipment and character notes. Uses Quest Portal’s character-sheet components. No account required. Drafts stay in your browser where the host permits; export JSON for a portable backup. Explicitly Attach a draft to share current values with ChatGPT. Roll d20 tests and damage with inline results, and optionally connect private guest play sessions for explicitly requested dice monitoring. No cloud character library or device sync. Based on the openly licensed SRD 5.2.1; not an official Wizards of the Coast product.
defaultPrompt: Help me create a D&D 5.5e character.
